title: Helm values: list-typed pod-spec fields default to [] not {}
answers: helm lint warning cannot overwrite table with non table
why does helm lint complain when a values file sets a list field
default value for a list field in chart values.yaml
body:
Symptom: running helm lint on a values file that sets a list-valued pod field (e.g. topologySpreadConstraints) prints "warning: cannot overwrite table with non table ... (map[])".
Root cause: charts/values.yaml declared the default as {} (a map), so Helm treats the key as a table and cannot replace it with a list.
Fix pattern: declare list-valued pod spec defaults as [] next to tolerations: [], and guard the template with {{- with .Values.<key> }} in charts/templates/deployment.yaml so the key is omitted when empty.
Constraints: applies to list fields such as tolerations and topologySpreadConstraints. Map fields like nodeSelector and affinity keep {}. Rendering still works with the wrong type, so only helm lint catches it.
applies: Any new list-valued key added to the MLflow Helm chart values and pod template.
says: Validating deployment settings warns that pod scheduling rules cannot overwrite a table.
Allow administrators to configure custom pod spreading rules without deployment package warnings.
Our installation package validation reports type conflicts on custom pod toleration lists.
Deployment template checks flag warnings when setting list values for pod distribution.
search: In the MLflow Helm chart, list-typed pod-spec fields in charts/values.yaml must default to [] instead of {}. Declaring {} causes helm lint to issue a cannot overwrite table with non table warning when setting list fields such as topologySpreadConstraints or tolerations. Templates in charts/templates/deployment.yaml must wrap the field with {{- with .Values.<key> }} to omit empty keys, whereas map fields like nodeSelector and affinity retain {}. Applies to any new list-valued key added to chart values and pod templates, which only helm lint catches since template rendering still succeeds.
